text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I've been thinking about doing some<n>hiking over
the weekend for a<n>breather, so I hit the shops and
run<n>into none other than Tarumae.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Going hiking sounds like a great way<n>to unwind!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
There are some great beginner trails<n>you could start
with, and you could<n>gradually work your way up to
real<n>mountain hikes.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
(Wait, am I being a buzzkill? I-I mean,<n>it's just
honest advice. And<n>Trainer's not looking upset
about it,<n>like last time...)
choice_data_list: You sound like a pro. I'd appreciate your advice!
You sound like a pro. I'd appreciate your advice!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Oh! R-right...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
(Now what? I don't want to rain on<n>their parade by
being too serious or<n>anything.)

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
(But... This is my opportunity to give a<n>little
something back for all the stuff<n>Trainer's taught
me. It should be fine,<n>as long as I don't say
anything<n>harsh.)
choice_data_list: Tarumae?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
...Huh? S-sorry, I was just thinking!<n>I'd be glad to
give you some hiking<n>pointers!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
A good hike starts with good shoes!<n>Hiking boots
come in various styles,<n>so it's important to pick a
pair that<n>suits your needs.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I'm glad she's here to walk me<n>through this. She
seems really<n>knowledgeable!
choice_data_list: How about these big, sturdy-looking ones?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Oh, these high-cut ones are actually<n>mountaineering
boots.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
...So, um, they're designed for snow<n>and steep,
rigorous climbs! For casual<n>hiking, I'd recommend
mid-cut hiking<n>boots like these.
choice_data_list: Ooh, okay! I'll go with these, then!
Ooh, okay! I'll go with these, then!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
(Whew, okay. These boots should<n>work much
better! But they're not<n>upset I shot down the other
pair, are<n>they? No, they seem fine...)

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Next up is a hiking outfit! Is there<n>anything particular
you're looking<n>for?
choice_data_list: Hmm... What do you recommend?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Hmm... Well, let me think...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
(You'd want layers to adjust to<n>temperature
changes, so we should<n>start with a quick-dry base
layer. For<n>a beginner, performance is more<n>important
than fashion...)

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
(But the functional ones look so<n>boring. Maybe it'd
be better if I<n>suggest something fun, since it's<n>just
a casual hike...)

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
What do you think of this jacket? It's<n>a brand-new
design from a popular<n>brand, and it looks like the
kind of<n>style you'd like!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
...I can't put a finger on it, but<n>something feels off.
Tarumae is<n>usually more practical, and she's<n>been
watching my each little reaction<n>nervously.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: I've got to lighten the mood!
choice_data_list:
Actually, I kinda like the trench coat on display in
that store!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Huh? Wait, what?! A tr-tre-trenchcoat?! For hiking?
choice_data_list: Haha, just kidd—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Y-yeah, that sounds good too! It's<n>super stylish...
Let's go over and<n>have a look!
choice_data_list: Tarumae, wait! I was just kidding!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I thought it was pretty clearly a joke,<n>but she
seems to have taken me<n>seriously. I'm kinda
worried about<n>how tense she is, and hurry over to
stop her...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Um, I think this should be everything<n>you need for a
beginner-level hike!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
With Tarumae's help, I'm all set for<n>my mountain
adventure. I've got to<n>do something to pay her
back.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
She's been kinda down, and I<n>accidentally ran her
for a loop with my<n>dumb attempt at a joke, so this
time<n>for sure—I've got an idea to help her<n>relax.
choice_data_list: Hey, Tarumae? If you're free, I was wondering...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Mmm... It's nice getting some fresh<n>air. And the trail
is really<n>well-maintained, so this should be a<n>breeze!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Look, there's a birds' nest!<n>Heheh! The little
birds glid'n nearby<n>probably just learned to fly.
choice_data_list: Maybe they're practicing how to find food.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
They might be! Heh, this is one of my<n>favorite
things about hiking—the<n>chance to watch nature
working its<n>magic.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
It takes me back... I hiked the<n>mountains back home
a million times.<n>Mount Tarumae also has some
adorable birds called pipits!
choice_data_list:
(She's back to her usual self... I'm glad she came
along.)

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Then, I spot a patch of beautiful<n>wildflowers on my
side of the trail. I<n>reach down to grab one to show
her,<n>but—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: NO! Don't touch that!
choice_data_list: Huh?!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Are you okay?! ...Oh, thank goodness.<n>That
could've been bad.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
...You have to be careful with wild<n>plants. Some of
them have irritants or<n>poison, or could be hiding
dangerous<n>bugs.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Even if it was safe, you still shouldn't<n>pick flowers.
The best thing you can<n>do to preserve nature is
leave it<n>alone!
choice_data_list: I-I'm sorry! I shouldn't have done that...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Oh.
choice_data_list: Thanks for keeping me outta trouble. I really—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: I'm so, so sorry! I didn't... mean to...
choice_data_list:
...Tarumae. I'm glad you're looking out for me.
Let's take a photo of the flowers instead.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... Yeah, that's fine. And sorry<n>again... A
photo's a great idea.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
She's got a weak, forced smile. A<n>little uneasy, I
take a quick photo and<n>we continue awkwardly
along the<n>trail.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
After a while, we reach a rest area. I<n>hardly noticed
the time, but the sun's<n>already starting to set. The
view from<n>up here is stunning in the soft light.
choice_data_list: The sunset's beautiful, isn't it?
The sunset's beautiful, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Ah, yes! I'm glad you're enjoying<n>the view.
Getting to see everything<n>from up high is one of
hiking's<n>charms, huh?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Tarumae's got that strained look<n>again. I invited her
out to unwind, not<n>wear her out more...
choice_data_list:
Sorry, you must be exhausted, spending your time
off marching around the hills...

Sorry, you must be exhausted, spending your time
off marching around the hills...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
No, not at all! I'm really glad I was<n>able to share my
hobby with you.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
If anything, I'm the one who's sorry<n>for, you
know... raining on your<n>parade when you were just
trying to<n>have fun and enjoy nature.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: ..."Have fun and enjoy nature"?<n>Don't tell me...
choice_data_list: You're still thinking about that flower patch?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... Even if it was dangerous, I<n>shouldn't have
been so snippy about<n>it. I'm sorry.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
And making a fuss about<n>preservation over just
one flower...<n>that was really harsh of me.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: That's not true. I messed up, and shetaught me why I shouldn't be doingwhat I did. That's not "snippy," it'sjust being considerate.
choice_data_list:
Not at all! I appreciate how much you know about
hiking. I've been learning tons!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Trainer... Ehehe, thank you.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
...You're always too kind—looking out<n>for my
feelings like this.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Compared to you, I'm...
choice_data_list: ...Tarumae?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Nothing! You must be getting hungry,<n>right? Let's
head down and have<n>ourselves a nice dinner!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
She's got her bright idol voice and<n>smile... but I can
tell she's putting up<n>a front.
